chapter: Brawls, the Ink Spots and boyhood recollections
title: Nazarro's trick of telling each partner the other was dishonest
summary: Nazarro told Buck that a man of Bubbles' complexion was dishonest and told Bubbles the reverse, to separate the team.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: Just to think Nazarro got to the point where he thought he was going to break up the team of Buck and Bubbles because I didn't want to sign no more contracts because my mother told me not to sign for a couple of days and he was trying to beg me to sign before the contract runs out. I said no, mama says that I should take a little rest. So while I'm taking a little rest, that's when I missed that I didn't have the-Buck's contract, the partnership, and he took Buck and told him a story to the extent of what his father told him. His father told him that Buck was half a shade lighter than me, you know. He would say to Buck, you know, my father told me a colored fella with your complexion is honest but a fella with your partner's complexion, he dishonest and he put all the bad marks on me. He tell my partner this. He's going to separate Buck and Bubbles, you know. But I was determined he wasn't going to do it, but I didn't tell him this, you know.
So I said to Buck one day -- so

he told me, he said to me, his father told him that a fella my color was honest and a fella Buck's color was dishonest, understand? So Buck had it one side and I had the other side. So one day I said to Buck, I said, "Buck, did Nazarro ever tell you that a fella your color was dishonest and a fella my color was honest?" Just the opposite, just the opposite. You get my point? I can't tell him the truth of it or he won't tell me his story, 'cause he knows the man told him that he was good and I was bad and I'm telling him the man says he was bad and I was good. I'm telling him about this so he says, yeah, but I know he's telling me wrong because he told me just the opposite way. You know? Now ain't that something. Now my partner don't trust me because his father told-- this fella's father told him what I was and what he was. And I let him do that. That's what this guy was doing. Now how would I detect that. Think about that. How would I detect that. Get my point? Ain't that somethin' for a guy to do?
